unit3_direct_service_evidence: Unit-3 ITAAC 2.2.01.08 Attachment A marks P30Z in the category 'spare or a penetration containing low voltage instrumentation/communication circuits' excluded from the penetration-current protection analysis; later Unit-3 inspection physically observes installed P30Z terminations for PXS-PL-V130A indication cable PLV130AQZB variants, PRHR V108A cable PLV108ARZB, IRWST squib-valve cable PLV123ANZB and SFS cables PLV075HZB/PLV033HZB, so the as-built Unit-3 penetration is not spare. Unit-3 qualification table independently maps P30Z to low-voltage EPA qualification reports APP-EY01-VBR-003/-004
cross_unit_or_family_evidence: Certified AP1000 DCD Rev.19 Sec.8.3.1.1.6 requires electrical penetrations to conform to the same functional service level as the cables: low-level instrumentation is separate from power/control; conductor modules in a penetration are of the same service class. Unit-4 P30Z was independently sampled as an instrumentation penetration
resolved_service_content: P30Z is a Division-B Class-1E low-voltage instrumentation/communication-service EPA in the as-built Unit-3 configuration. Certified service-class separation prevents importing low-voltage power/control feedthrough modules into P30Z merely because PXS/SFS equipment cables terminate there
